title: Chapter 460 Counterattack Before Death
content:
Chapter 460 Counterattack Before Death

Seeing that a god had died, the morale of the rest of the deserted city suddenly increased.

Yun Qi expanded to the extreme, and pointed the sword in his hand at the other five gods in the middle of the battlefield, shouting: "You can't surrender quickly if you don't have the beast!"

The sword sounded in Huang Shou's hand. Looking at the gods fighting against him in front of him, he also said coldly: "You are in a predicament, don't make any unnecessary struggles."

Although they have indeed gained an advantage now, these gods have managed the land of the gods for endless years, so they may not be able to do anything amazing.

If you can completely defeat the opponent's psychological defense with words, it would be better.

Hearing the words of the powerful men in the Huangcheng City, the only five gods left had no fear on their faces, as if they could not fail.

Among them, the god with the most powerful aura was silent for a moment and suddenly burst into a fierce laugh.

"Are you so confident that you can take down my land of gods? So I wonder what you should do next?"

He smiled gloomyly at the people of the deserted city, while madly mobilizing the remaining energy of the entire land of gods. For a moment, his momentum was surging, and the attack made everyone unable to help retreat slightly, avoiding the edge.

The next moment, all the strong men in the wilderness city in the field were stunned, staring blankly at the remaining remnant gods in the land of the gods.

I saw that the other four gods suddenly showed a look of sacrificing their lives and their terrifying aura became more and more restrained.

Under the shocked gaze of everyone, the four gods lost their vitality and died.

The sudden change did not make the people in Huangcheng feel a little happy, but instead made them frown and their faces turn ashen.

It was just because these four gods sacrificed their bodies and left all their power to the remaining god.

That is the only god in the land of all gods.

"Hahahahahaha, since you dare to offend me the land of the gods, then stay all of them!"

He was wearing a red robe and covered in blood. The colors on his clothes could no longer be distinguished from the original color or the color of blood, and he looked extremely creepy.

The red eyes were filled with strong murderous intent, and they swept across everyone present one by one.

"You all want to die!"

There was a rumbling sound.

The Red God stomped through the void and rushed towards the people of Huangcheng. His momentum was amazing, and he faintly overwhelmed the strong men of Huangcheng present.

Such a scene made Lu Xue and others, who were on the edge of the divine pillar and intended to continue to destroy, look pale.

No one would have thought that these gods were so brave and sacrificed themselves directly.

"My master, what should I do now?"

Ao Qing looked at the people in the wild city who were trapped in danger and looked at Lu Xuedao with a worried expression.

Now they are at a disadvantage. Facing this only god, Huang Shou and others were beaten backwards repeatedly and had no power to resist.

The entire void was broken into nothingness, filled with chaos.

After this battle, the Land of Gods became a forbidden zone for life.

Lu Xue frowned and stared at the divine pillar not far away. As the four gods fell, these corresponding divine pillars also lost their breath and were covered with shocking cracks.

But there is one left!

Lu Xue looked at the breath and saw that the divine pillar was actually broken and even more exaggerated than the other divine pillars, and it was already vaguely collapsed.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue's face looked extremely ugly.

She knew that this meant that the god was ready to die with them.

"Damn it, why is this happening!"

Lu Xue gritted her teeth and was helpless for a moment.

And at this moment, a familiar and abrupt voice came from the sky.

"Hahahaha, you won't call me when you hit the land of the gods. At the critical moment, you still have to rely on me to appear!"

Lu Xue suddenly looked up at the void, her face stunned.

Ao Qing on the side also had a strange look on his face.

"Is that guy serious?"

Around him, Wu Hui and others looked puzzled, "Senior Lu Xue, who is coming to help?"

They were a little excited because the ones who came to support them at this time would definitely not be ordinary people, and they might really be able to turn the tables.

But seeing Lu Xue's face, they gave up this idea again.

If the support is strong, Lu Xue would not have this expression.

Hearing everyone's inquiries, Lu Xue sighed helplessly.

Outside the sky.

Everyone in the Huangcheng City took action together, but they were still at a disadvantage, which shocked and frightened them. They absorbed the power of the other gods, making his combat power extremely powerful.

It's no longer something they can deal with.

Is it going to be a failure?

And at this moment, a strange aura came towards this place.

Judging from the posture, it seems that it is still a helper. Who will it be?

A light source emerged, and a man with a young appearance appeared in everyone's sight. He was wearing a tight long gown, with long hair raised, and his face was filled with seven-point confidence and three-point pride.

"Sister Xue, you wouldn't think of the opportunity I got when I returned to the Moon Clan, and you would never think of me being able to come directly to this battlefield to fight side by side with you."

Yueming murmured in his heart, his eyes on the battlefield.

"Hmm? Why is it a little different from what I imagined?"

Seeing that the people in Huangcheng besieged one person on the battlefield, no, it was the scene where everyone in Huangcheng besieged one person, Yueming couldn't react for a moment.

"you,,"

The Red God did not look at Yue Ming for a long time, but just threw out a divine light at will.

Bang!

Yueming immediately vomited blood and flew backwards.

This small episode did not affect everyone's battle. The next moment, the people in Huangcheng continued to work together and started fighting with the Red God.

"I just knew that kid was unreliable."

Ao Qing snorted lightly, "I didn't expect that the master would miss it all day."

Lu Xue shook her head and said, "At least, he still has the courage to fight against the gods."

Ao Qing did not refute this sentence.

Rumble!

The huge sound sounded from not far away, and the giant pillars that reached the sky had begun to fall in love at this moment, and the land of the gods instantly became empty.

Lu Xue noticed that the divine pillar corresponding to the only living god was the first to fall.

In this way, do this so-called god have any weaknesses?

"Brother Yueming, I didn't expect that you are still so weak after not seeing you for so long, hahaha."

Outside the land of the gods, a slender girl looked at Yue Ming's embarrassed figure and smiled unscrupulously.

Hearing this familiar voice, Yueming suddenly opened his eyes, looked up, and immediately saw his white and tender little face.

"Xiao Jing, it's you, you actually came to the land of the gods!"

Jing nodded and said arrogantly: "Of course, how could I miss this excitement? And Senior Lu said, let me protect Sister Xue, of course I have to follow you."

"But Sister Xue doesn't know, and she won't let me take action."

Speaking of this, a trace of grievance appeared on Jing's face, "I'm obviously very strong, but Sister Xue just let me watch it, insisting that I'm not doing anything light or heavy, I'm obviously very careful."
